item.title: St. Pete breaks ground on largest affordable housing project at former Tibbetts Lumber site
item.description: St. Petersburg leaders broke ground on the 264-unit affordable and workforce housing development in the city on Wednesday.Former Florida Senator Jeff Brandes grew up on the nearly seven acres located at 3300 Fairfield Avenue South in St. Pete.
